Film name: Sunday Morning

Characters

1. तरुण - 42 years, father
Look: light beard, blue T-shirt, grey pyjamas
2. प्रिया - 40 years, mother
Look: cotton kurta, hair in a bun
3. वृंदा - 10 years, elder daughter
Look: round glasses, ponytail, yellow T-shirt
4. वनुशा - 4 years, younger daughter
Look: short hair, pink frock

Backgrounds

1. the balcony - potted plants, a small table, a view of the street below
2. the kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots, a window
3. the street below - a quiet lane, parked scooters, a neem tree

Props

1. watering can - a green plastic watering can
2. bicycle - a small red bicycle with a bell
3. broom - a long grass broom

FADE IN

Scene one - the balcony - Sunrise

[The sun rises slowly over the rooftops. Birds sing.]

[तरुण stands on the balcony with a cup of tea and stretches his arms.]

[प्रिया waters the plants with the watering can.]

तरुण (yawning): "Good morning, sunshine."

प्रिया (laughing): "Are you talking to me or to the sun?"

Scene two - the kitchen - Morning

[प्रिया lights the gas stove. A blue flame jumps up under the pan.]

[वनुशा walks in slowly, rubbing her eyes. प्रिया combs her hair.]

वनुशा (sleepily): "Mama, I want a paratha. A big one!"

[वृंदा sweeps the floor with the broom, then puts it in the corner.]

वृंदा: "Can I take my cycle out? Please, please, please?"

प्रिया: "Yes."

Scene three - the street below - Morning

[वृंदा rides her red bicycle down the lane and rings the bell.]

[तरुण leans over the balcony railing and looks down at her.]

तरुण (shouting): "Slowly, वृंदा! Watch out for the scooters!"

वृंदा (waving): "Don't worry, Papa! I'm the best rider in the whole colony!"

[The phone rings. तरुण picks it up, turns away from the railing and goes inside.]
